name: LinkBermuda / Eastlink Teleport Data Centre
notes: Eastlink/LinkBermuda states it has two SOC 2 Type II certified data centres and identifies the Teleport Data Centre as located in Devonshire; Data Center Map lists LinkBermuda Teleport at 1 Middle Rd, Devonshire. Some directory/registry records also label 1 Middle Road as Smith's/Flatts, so the facility is recorded under Devonshire based on operator and data-center directory location evidence.

name: QuoVadis Datacentre / SecureCentre City
notes: Official QuoVadis page describes a Tier III-designed Bermuda datacentre located in central Hamilton. Oxygen, which uses the facility, says it was commissioned in January 2011 and describes N+N redundancy, dual 1MVA feeds, 850kW generator, dual 500kVA UPS systems, and high-density racks. Royal Gazette reported the Hamilton build in 2010.

name: Fireminds Bermuda Data Centre
notes: Bernews reported Fireminds launched a Bermuda-based data centre for cloud, managed hosting, and colocation, located at Waterfront Properties on Pitts Bay Road. A 2018 Bernews item described Fireminds' Bermuda data centers as SOC2 certified. Pitts Bay Road/Waterfront Properties is treated as Hamilton Municipality for this batch.

name: Government of Bermuda Data Centre, Information Technology Office
developer: Government of Bermuda Department of Information and Digital Technologies
notes: Bermuda Yellow Pages lists the Government of Bermuda Data Centre / Information Technology Office at the Government Administration Building, 30 Parliament St., City of Hamilton, and describes secure IT infrastructure hosting applications and disaster recovery systems for government departments.

name: Power House / North Rock Communications facility
developer: Par-la-Ville Trio / North Rock Communications / ACT / SwitchWorx
notes: Royal Gazette reported the Power House at 7 Par-la-Ville Road, Hamilton, was being built with uninterruptible power, redundancy, security, and 'data centre requirements' for businesses; North Rock Communications was a landlord/tenant. Later North Rock/Logic consolidation makes current data-centre operating status unclear, so status is unknown.
